```{r}
library(tidyverse)
final_real_info_fric <- long_format_info_fric %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = publication_status, 
              values_from = predicted_real_unavailability) %>%
  replace_na(list(Published = 0, `Non Published` = 0)) %>%
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, auction_before,
           auction_after, creneau) %>% 
  summarise(
            Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = sum(as.numeric(`Non Published`)),
            Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = sum(as.numeric(Published))
            ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}

first_stage_test_bis_predicted <- first_stage_data_info_fric %>%
  mutate(Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity,
    predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    #uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(creneau_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_creneau_unavailability = sum(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_creneau_unavailability = sum(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         #uneff_creneau_unavailability = sum(uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>%
  mutate(day_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_day_unavailability = sum(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_day_unavailability = sum(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         #uneff_day_unavailability = sum(uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(datetime)


price_data_predicted <- first_stage_test_bis_predicted %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, predicted_unavailability_creneau, predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         
         pub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         unpub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         # uneff_unavailability_trigger =
         #   max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau, uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         # 
         ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}

price_data_predicted_pub <- price_data_predicted %>%
  filter(unpub_unavailability_trigger !=1 | pub_unavailability_trigger !=1) %>%
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(
    auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before),
    reference_auction = if (any(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(auction_before[pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      sample(0:6, 1)
    },
    distance_auction = auction_before - reference_auction
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>% 
group_by(electricity_delivery_date, 
           pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau
           ) %>% 
  
    mutate(
    unavail_pub_level = ifelse(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau== 0,
         0, mean(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[pub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

    unavail_pub = unavail_pub_level* pub_unavailability_trigger,
    )%>% 
  
  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les distances entre -4 et 4
 
  ungroup() 


price_data_predicted_unpub <- price_data_predicted %>%
  filter(unpub_unavailability_trigger !=1 | pub_unavailability_trigger !=1) %>%
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(
    auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before),
    reference_auction = if (any(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(auction_before[unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      sample(0:6, 1)
    },
    distance_auction = auction_before - reference_auction
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>% 
group_by(electricity_delivery_date, 
           unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau
           ) %>% 
  
    mutate(
    unavail_unpub_level = ifelse(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau== 0,
         0, mean(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[unpub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

    unavail_unpub = unavail_unpub_level* unpub_unavailability_trigger,
    )%>% 
  
  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les distances entre -4 et 4
 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}

prepare_price_data_multiple <- function(data, unavail_cols) {
  results <- lapply(unavail_cols, function(unavail_col) {
    data %>%
      distinct(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, !!sym(unavail_col), .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, !!sym(unavail_col)) %>%
      select(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, !!sym(unavail_col), price_diff,
             gen_tot, unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables,
             reference_auction, Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity, 
             Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity, Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = distance_auction, 
                  names_prefix = paste0("price_", unavail_col, "_"), 
                  values_from = price_diff) %>%
      {
        price_cols <- grep(paste0("^price_", unavail_col, "_"), colnames(.), value = TRUE)
        price_cols_filtered <- price_cols[as.numeric(sub(paste0("price_", unavail_col, "_"), "", price_cols)) %in% -2:2]
        price_cols_sorted <- mixedsort(price_cols_filtered)
        non_price_cols <- setdiff(colnames(.), price_cols)
        .[, c(non_price_cols, price_cols_sorted)]
      }
  })
  
  # Combine results into a single dataframe
  reduce(results, full_join, by = c("electricity_delivery_date", "creneau", "gen_tot",
                                    "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables", "reference_auction"))
}


# Apply function
price_data_predicted_wide_test <- prepare_price_data_multiple(price_data_predicted_pub, c("unavail_pub","unavail_unpub"))

# Apply the function to each dataset
price_data_predicted_grouped_pub <- group_and_summarize(price_data_predicted_wide_pub, "unavail_pub")
price_data_predicted_grouped_unpub <- group_and_summarize(price_data_predicted_wide_unpub, "unavail_unpub")
```
